changes.title: Sail zoom held key
items: Sailing from the map table zooms into the sea chart again: holding the key, button or mouse to sail no longer skipped the zoom straight to a blue screen.

changes.title: Wakes in bed
items: She's in her bed from the first moment you see her: no more appearing outside the treehouse and sliding into bed as the loading screen fades, and the camera stays still.
Sleeping in the bed, she's tucked in as the room goes dark, and the room no longer jumps as she wakes up the next night.

changes.title: Treehouse decor stays put
items: The treehouse's plants, candles, rugs and other bits stay put on the floor as you walk about

changes.title: Whole island at load
items: The whole island is ready when the loading screen ends: no trees or creatures popping in, and no pause the first time you reach the beach.
Loading takes longer the first time you visit an island while all of it is drawn; after that it's quick.
